query:
-- Corrigir os 4 abastecimentos com type=other e valor errado
-- Cruzar com fuel_records para pegar o valor correto

UPDATE bpo_charges bc
JOIN fuel_records fr ON bc.asaas_charge_id = fr.asaas_charge_id
SET 
  bc.type = 'fuel',
  bc.value = fr.total_amount / 100
WHERE bc.id IN (900001, 900002, 900003, 900004)
  AND bc.description LIKE 'Abastecimento%';
